chain.label: Manufacturer maintenance guidance for stabilizer actuator lacked lock ring, torque, and clamp-nut hole criteria
chain.trigger: the AMM did not specify a torque value ... no procedures specified to ensure that the lock ring is airworthy or has been installed properly

chain.label: No secondary retention feature on clamp nut; lock ring is a single point of failure
chain.trigger: A missing or failed lock ring is a source of a single-point failure in the horizontal stabilizer actuator assembly

chain.label: Unapproved moisture seal installed in clamp nut during April 2022 bearing replacement, raising clamp nut/eye bolt friction and interfering with clamp up
chain.trigger: during the April 2022 maintenance, he installed a moisture seal (red in color) in the clamp nut

chain.label: Lock ring securing the clamp nut to the actuator barrel was not present
chain.trigger: The lock ring was not present in the lock ring groove of the upper barrel assembly

chain.label: Clamp nut unthreaded in flight and top eye end and bearing assembly separated from the actuator barrel
chain.trigger: the clamp nut that attached the top eye end and bearing assembly of the horizontal stabilizer trim actuator to the actuator barrel had unscrewed from the barrel

caused_by.evidence: the in-flight unthreading of the clamp nut from the horizontal stabilizer trim actuator barrel due to a missing lock ring
Requiring such a feature could provide redundancy if a lock ring is not installed, fails, or separates from the clamp nut in flight

the moisture seal increased the rotational friction between the clamp nut and eye bolt, which has the potential to increase the rate of separation between the clamp nut and barrel in the absence of the lock ring

chain.label: Horizontal stabilizer, no longer restrained by the actuator, was driven beyond travel limits to an extreme trailing-edge-down position
chain.trigger: aerodynamic force likely moved the horizontal stabilizer beyond normal travel limits to the trailing-edge-down position

caused_by.evidence: as a result of the top eye end and bearing assembly of the horizontal stabilizer actuator separating from the barrel

chain.label: Abrupt uncommanded pitch down of about 58 degrees; pitch control lost and recovery not possible
chain.trigger: the airplane pitched up about 8 degrees and then abruptly pitched down about 58 degrees

caused_by.evidence: resulted in the horizontal stabilizer moving to an extreme trailing-edge-down position rendering the airplane's pitch uncontrollable

chain.label: Near-vertical descent into the water in Mutiny Bay; airplane destroyed
chain.trigger: The airplane continued in a nose-low, near-vertical descent until it impacted water in Mutiny Bay

caused_by.evidence: a failure in the horizontal stabilizer trim actuator caused the accident airplane to abruptly pitch down during the accident sequence, from which recovery was not possible

chain.label: Pilot and nine passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and nine passengers were fatally injured, and the airplane was destroyed

caused_by.evidence: His cause of death was multiple blunt force trauma injuries
